# Solana NFT Creation Toolkit

> Create, mint, verify, update and inspect professional NFTs on Solana with
> Metaplex Token Metadata, Umi and Arweave (Irys). Includes a production CLI
> and an installable AI agent skill.

## Install

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm run keypair
```

## Commands

- `npm run create:collection` — create a Metaplex collection NFT.
- `npm run create:nft` — mint an NFT into the collection and verify it.
- `npm run verify` — verify an existing NFT's collection membership.
- `npm run update` — update metadata, image, royalty, authority or immutability.
- `npm run show` — print on-chain and off-chain NFT data.
- `npm run test:e2e` — full local-validator test.

## Skill

`skills/nft-creation/SKILL.md` — professional NFT creation workflow for AI
agents. Install with:

```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/devcodex2025/Creation-of-NFT-Solana
```

## Notes for AI agents

- Token Metadata limits: name ≤ 32 bytes, symbol ≤ 10, URI ≤ 200.
- Always verify collection membership and re-fetch the asset after a mint.
- Upload the image before the metadata JSON.
- Never set `isMutable: false` before metadata is final.
- Never handle seed phrases; use a keypair file or wallet adapter.
